ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The antisense gene of a certain gene can inhibit the expression of that gene. To study the effects of tomato X gene and Y gene on fruit ripening, a research group used non-transgenic tomato plants (Group A, namely the control group), transgenic plants with antisense X gene (Group B), and transgenic plants with antisense Y gene (Group C) as materials to conduct an experiment. On different days (d) after the tomato plants grew fruits, the ethylene release amount of the fruits in each group was detected respectively (the higher the ethylene content in the fruit, the greater the ethylene release amount). The results are shown in the following table. Answer: If the protein expressed by the X gene was not detected in the fruits of Group B, and the protein expressed by the Y gene was not detected in the fruits of Group C, it can be inferred that what genes related to ethylene content are there in the fruits of Group A?
